ValidationRule.description: SS-6500 - Server Deployment - validate end user email domain to match the domains from the account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/*Taas record type*/ AND( IF(ISBLANK(TaaS_Admin_email__c), NOT(OR( CONTAINS(Account__r.Domain__c, RIGHT( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email ,(LEN( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )-FIND("@", Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )))), CONTAINS(Account__r.Other_Domains__c, RIGHT( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email ,(LEN( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )-FIND("@", Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email ))))) ), NOT(OR( CONTAINS(Account__r.Domain__c, RIGHT( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email ,(LEN( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )-FIND("@", Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )))), CONTAINS(Account__r.Other_Domains__c, RIGHT( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email ,(LEN( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )-FIND("@", Tanium_Cloud_Admin__r.Email )))), CONTAINS(Account__r.Other_Domains__c, RIGHT(TaaS_Admin_email__c,(LEN( TaaS_Admin_email__c )-FIND("@", TaaS_Admin_email__c )))), CONTAINS(Account__r.Domain__c, RIGHT(TaaS_Admin_email__c,(LEN( TaaS_Admin_email__c )-FIND("@", TaaS_Admin_email__c ))))) ) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'TaaS', TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c) = "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government", TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c) = "Tanium as a Service"), ISBLANK(Domain_Exception_Reason__c), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) ) ||
/*On-Prem record type*/ AND( NOT( OR( CONTAINS(Account__r.Other_Domains__c, RIGHT(License_delivery_email_primary__c,(LEN(License_delivery_email_primary__c)-FIND("@",License_delivery_email_primary__c)))), CONTAINS( Account__r.Domain__c, RIGHT(License_delivery_email_primary__c,(LEN(License_delivery_email_primary__c)-FIND("@",License_delivery_email_primary__c)))) ) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'OnPrem', TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c) = "On-Prem"), ISBLANK(Domain_Exception_Reason__c), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the email to match the domain on the account or populate the domain exception reason.
